text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While strolling around the shrine grounds with Kiseki, who has been feeling a bit off lately...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Could that be Digital-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Pyaah!?!?
K-K-Kiseki-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence, running into you here!
Ah, could it be... were you looking at the ema?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I totally get why you'd want to look at these!
Sometimes there are really elaborate ema
with illustrations drawn on them... like—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat!?
The drawing on this ema...
is super cute...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the ema Kiseki was staring at,
an Umamusume character was drawn.
Surprisingly, the line work on the illustration is remarkably clean.
choice_data_list: Amazing! What a meticulously detailed drawing...!
Amazing! What a meticulously detailed drawing...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The way they drew these shadows
really brings out the texture...!
They must have paid incredible attention to detail.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—Oooofff...!!!
Ngh...! *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So amazing... I wonder who drew this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
W-W-W-Whaaat~~~!?
Who could you possibly be talking about~!?
Whew~ whew-whew~♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, but the art style feels like
something I've seen before...
Oh, there's a wish written next to the illustration.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...'I wish...
I could get better at drawing'—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No no no no no!
I don't know about that one~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"For me, it's more like I'm just fretting on my own that I should be able to express the world's preciousness way better...
I don't really think it's such a noble wish or anything...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, that's a truly admirable wish.
Even though you're already this good,
you're still not satisfied with your current ability.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She's so stoic that I truly respect her... But still—!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to lose either...!
I'll get better and better, just you watch!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna surpass this person, too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Can I hang up an ema plaque too!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Paint the hair at the end—alright, finished!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what do you think of this illustration!
I think I drew it pretty cool!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, all that's left is to write down our wishes, right?
...Of course, what I'm wishing for is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "May I create the 'hottest' masterpiece in the world!" That's my wish!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, perhaps because of his renewed resolve,
Kiseki's condition fully recovered!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward,
I went to buy an ema with Kiseki, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... To think the head priest isn't here!
Back in my day, there was always... *cough cough*!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
What am I supposed to do with all this restlessness...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, I just have to pour it into my manga!
Woooaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki couldn't even hang up her drawn ema plaque,
and her condition failed to recover...
